mentions.name: Ranktools
mentions.description: This SaaS generates SEO leads by building interactive content — tools, calculators, and generators — on users' websites. It publishes the content, builds backlinks on autopilot, and captures leads via calls-to-action embedded directly in the tools. A human reviews every piece of content before it goes live.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building https://ranktools.io
An SEO lead generation SaaS that builds interactive content on user’s websites.

Ranktools builds content like tools, calculators, generators - publishes them, builds backlinks on autopilot and generates leads via CTAs built directly into the tools.
